improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it.
Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
improve.coach: 41% overall, same lately. Our next project.

improve.title: Defensive work rate
tips: Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball.
improve.coach: 35% overall, 20% in your last five. Better every week.

improve.title: Passing accuracy
tips: Scan before the ball gets to you - a quick shoulder check means you already know the pass before you need it.
Count your touches. Two-touch is a habit that keeps your head up and the ball moving.
If you're pressed from behind, play it back the way you're facing. Don't turn into trouble.
improve.coach: It used to come up 35% of the time; now it's 20%. Progress.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: You found the corner like it owed you rent. 53% of matches. Elite habit.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: Making your teammates look good is the most generous thing in football. 41% of the time. That's your superpower.
